[Sharpness of quadratic decay (Remark 27.27)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0037 1. ch27:27.27\group Nonflat shrinkers

Kähler shrinkers on powers of tautological line bundles have Euclidean volume growth and quadratic scalar-curvature decay.
